author: The Infographics Show
description:
Why did tech companies kill the SD card? The official excuses involve waterproofing, limited space, and slower performance. But the real reason may be far more profitable. Expandable storage allowed customers to own their files without paying smartphone manufacturers hundreds of dollars for storage upgrades or monthly cloud subscriptions.

This video examines how Apple, Samsung, Google, and other major technology companies shifted consumers from physical storage toward expensive internal memory and cloud services. A tiny increase in flash memory can cost manufacturers relatively little, yet customers are charged hundreds more for higher-capacity phones. Without a microSD slot, users are forced to upgrade, delete files, or rent additional storage every month.

title: The Storage ECONOMY Is Broken. MicroSD Is OBLITERATED.
